Index-addressed nodes in an arena (), one kind per visible production of grammars/xpath (), names as written (1.12 resolves them), a source location per node. Covers every construct the slice uses, notably inline functions with types, EQName function references, ? placeholders, static and dynamic =>, map{} and {}, square and curly arrays, ?*, ?(expr), unary lookup, and sequence types such as map(K, V), function(T) as U, array(empty-sequence()).
